review_protocol.note: Seven requested roles were covered by three independent read-only agents; this file does not imply seven independent agents. Recommendations below are retained even when later mechanical blockers were resolved.

reviews.summary: The MACE case is correctly limited to an infrastructure-only negative result, with correct mace-torch version, force-component-MAE units, relative changes, threshold decisions, and binary rerun interpretation.
strengths: Both rejection decisions and negative evidence are preserved.
No checkpoint-improvement or physical-validity claim is made.
weaknesses: One device and two one-step trials cannot support a scientific result.
No frozen-test, physical-property, uncertainty, or provider replication evidence exists.
blocking_issues: At review time the MACE method fields and approved label view were not fully bound to public evidence.
claim_corrections: Describe iteration 2 as crossing an infrastructure decision threshold, not improving model quality.
missing_baselines: A second device/provider replay would strengthen a future reproducibility study.
missing_citations: A MACE-MP model-card citation would be needed only if the exact checkpoint were named publicly.

reviews.summary: The paper makes no active-learning performance or sample-efficiency claim and explicitly states that no acquisition labels were accessed.
strengths: The scope excludes acquisition efficiency and protected labels.
The real-MACE replay is not misrepresented as an active-learning campaign.
weaknesses: The work provides no evidence about query strategy, sample efficiency, or uncertainty calibration.
missing_baselines: No acquisition baseline is needed for the current infrastructure-only question.
missing_citations: No active-learning citation is required without an active-learning claim.

reviews.summary: Independent recomputation confirmed 52 records, 48 corrupt cases, four clean controls, 12 balanced families, semantic macro/micro recall 1.0, manifest macro/micro recall 1/12, and macro-recall gain 11/12.
strengths: The primary result is numerically correct.
The clean-control statement avoids population inference.
Amendment A-001 discloses the initial macro/micro representation error without rerunning cases.
weaknesses: The four seeds are deterministic instantiations, not independent samples.
Fault-family weights are hand-defined and balanced by construction.
blocking_issues: At review time the analysis trusted macro fields in summary.json instead of deriving them from the ledger.
The preregistered wall_seconds endpoint was under-specified and unreported.
claim_corrections: Report macro and micro for both methods.
Treat elapsed timing only as a non-inferential diagnostic.
missing_baselines: A schema-only validator or stronger immutable-manifest baseline would be more informative.

reviews.summary: A temporary rerun reproduced every decision and summary endpoint, but timing-bearing ledger rows were not byte-identical. The paper therefore must promise deterministic outcomes rather than deterministic ledger bytes.
strengths: The research specification content hash recomputes.
Remote source hashes and MACE calculations match private artifacts.
The build uses shell escape disabled and official ICML assets.
weaknesses: The initial reproduction command targeted the frozen default output directory.
blocking_issues: At review time public evidence locators were unresolved.
At review time the PDF embedded an absolute local figure path.
Cleanup, round-state, retry, and method bindings were incomplete.
claim_corrections: Say deterministic decisions and aggregate endpoints.
Require a distinct reproduction output directory.
format_issues: Rebuild in a neutral isolated directory and scan PDF strings.

reviews.summary: The framing is materially safer, but the experiment remains a white-box self-test of repository-defined invariants rather than independent robustness evidence.
strengths: The architecture separates proposal, execution, evaluation, decision, and evidence release.
The paper preserves failures and uses a fail-closed claim ceiling.
weaknesses: Eleven of twelve faults are designed to evade a refreshable manifest.
Fault and grader authors share the same contract.
blocking_issues: At review time required audit and submission files were absent.
claim_corrections: Do not use general robustness or superiority language.
missing_citations: Provenance-system and mutation-testing context would strengthen future positioning.

reviews.summary: Spot checks found that the cited primary sources support their local sentences; Hsueh et al. supports controlled fault injection and official PyTorch documentation supports the exact-equality caveat.
strengths: No citation is used to support the new experimental counts.
weaknesses: Related work on provenance and mutation testing is thin.
claim_corrections: Do not let related-work citations imply independent fault authorship.
missing_citations: in-toto/SLSA or mutation-testing citations are optional future additions, not blockers for the narrowed claim.

reviews.summary: The adversarial reviewer attempted to reject the paper and concluded that the finite-catalog result is honest but close to a self-confirming unit test. They retained a weak-reject scientific recommendation even if packaging blockers were repaired.
strengths: MACE negative evidence and T2 ceiling are explicit.
The final title and abstract disclaim arbitrary robustness.
weaknesses: No independently authored held-out fault set.
blocking_issues: At review time public evidence was unresolved, required JSON audits were missing, and PDF path anonymity was fragile.
claim_corrections: Retain excluded claims and infrastructure_only status.
Do not convert 0/4 clean rejections into a false-positive-rate estimate.
missing_baselines: Held-out faults or a materially stronger baseline.
missing_citations: Artifact provenance and mutation-testing literature would improve novelty positioning.
format_issues: A public repository draft PR can reveal authorship even when the PDF is anonymous; treat repository publication and anonymous conference submission as distinct disclosure channels.

consensus.release_after_mechanical_fixes: mixed: two groups conditional weak-accept; adversarial systems reviewer retains weak-reject for limited novelty and self-confirming design

unanimous_mechanical_findings: Required files and public evidence locators are complete.
All dependent hashes and sizes resolve.
The public text and PDF scans contain no searched identity, path, or commit leaks.
Claim, citation, and format audits pass.
final_verification.unresolved_scientific_scope_limitation: No independently authored held-out fault suite or competitive provenance baseline was added; this remains explicit in the paper and prevents a general robustness claim.
